headline: Colonial Inroads Strike Linn of Mercy and Nevish Line
war_summary: Fresh territorial breaches have expanded the northern fighting over the past three hours, led by Colonial forces seizing Rotdust in Linn of Mercy and capturing Grief Mother along the Nevish Line. High-intensity combat endures across Weathered Expanse, where repeated clashes around Crow's Nest and Frostmarch continue to generate local base turnover and heavy casualties, though overall casualty rates have moderated slightly from earlier peaks. In Palantine Berm, fighting around Leiri Hermanni has slowed following its earlier capture, though regional casualty lists remain elevated. Mooring County and Callahan's Passage continue to record massive casualty tolls exceeding hundreds of losses per hour, yet frontline shifts have paused as local combat rates cool. Meanwhile, formerly turbulent sectors along Stlican Shelf, Stonecradle, and Farranac Coast have grown largely quiet, logging negligible base activity as both armies entrench their current lines.
